title: Geologic map of the Poinsett State Park quadrangle, Richland and Sumter counties, South Carolina
citation: Meitzen, K.M., Howard, C.S., and Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 2009, Geologic map of the Poinsett State Park quadrangle, Richland and Sumter counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-46, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Large map sheet with OCR'd text in columns; quotes are single-line excerpts. OCR symbols 'tq', '[ts' read as Td, Tls from the map. 29 SCGS drill-hole labels read on the map face; one printed '13-140' recorded as 43-140 (inferred, unclear), matching section B-B'. 43-167 (66 ft of alluvium) and 43-135 (35 ft of eolian sand, Lonestar quadrangle) from the text. Sections A-A', B-B' (vertical exaggeration 20) and C-C' read for end labels, hole labels and unit labels; contacts and hole depths not digitized; sections are extrapolated below drill-hole bases per the sheet. SUBSURFACE: fault offsets of the Paleocene-Pliocene and Upper Cretaceous-Paleocene contacts (Fuller's Earth Creek, section B-B'); up to 15 ft relief on the sub-alluvial surface (Eastover data).
